questions.question: What will be the ratio of Highest common Factor and Least Common Multiple of two numbers 16 and 20?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

16 = 2⁴

20 = 2² × 5

∵ HCF is the product of the common factors and LCM is the product of the highest powers of all the factors

LCM of (16, 20) = 2⁴ × 5 = 80

HCF of (16, 20) = 2² = 4

⇒ HCF / LCM = 4 / 80 = 1 / 20

∴ Required ratio = 4 : 80 = 1 : 20

questions.question: Marked price of an article is 60% more than its cost price. If the article is sold at a profit of 20%, then what will be the discount percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (MP) = 160% of Cost price (C.P.)

Profit = 20%

**Formula used:**

Cost price × (100 + Profit percentage)/100 = Selling price

Marked Price × (100 - Discount percentage)/100 = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be 100 and discount percentage be D

So, Marked price = 160 and Selling price = 120

According to Question,

160 × (100 - D)/100 = 120

⇒ (100 - D) = 3 × 100/4

⇒ 100 - D = 75

⇒ D = 25

∴ Discount percentage = 25%

questions.question: The volume of a right circular cone is 2464 cm³. If the height of the cone is 12 cm, then what will be the radius of its base?
questions.solution:

Volume of cone = 2464 cm³ 

Height of cone = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cone = πR²H / 3

R = base radius of cone

H = height of cone

**Calculation:**

Let the base radius of cone be r

⇒ 2464 = πr² × 12 / 3

⇒ πr² = 616

⇒ (22 / 7) × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 28 × 7

⇒ r = 14 cm

**∴ Base radius of cone = 14 cm.**

questions.question: A and C together can complete a work in 120 days, C and E together can complete the same work in 80 days and A and E together can complete the same work in 160 days. In how many days A, C and E together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and C together can complete the work in days = 120

C and E together can complete the work in days = 80

A and E together can complete the work in days = 160

**Concept:**

In this type of question always consider the total work as LCM of individual number of days.

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work / Number of days

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of work be LCM of 120, 80, 160 i.e. 480 unit

Efficiency of A and C together = 480 / 120 = 4 unit / day

Efficiency of C and E together = 480 / 80 = 6 unit / day

Efficiency of A and E together = 480 / 160 = 3 unit / day

So efficiency of A, C, and E together = (4 + 6 + 3) / 2 = 13 / 2

∴ A, C, and E together can complete the work in days = 480 / (13 / 2) = 960 / 13 days

questions.question: 12 persons can complete half of a work in 9 days. How many persons can complete the same work (whole) in 6 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 persons can complete half of the work in 9 days.

**Formula used:**

(M × D) / W = Constant

Where,

M = number of persons

D = number of days

W = work

**Calculation:**

Let the person required to complete the work in 6 days be x

According to formula,

12 × 9 / (w / 2) = x × 6 / (w)

⇒ 6x = 24 × 9

⇒ x = 36

∴ Number of persons required to complete the work in 6 days = 36

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of room are 16 metres, 12 metres, and 15 metres. What will be the length of the largest rod that can be placed in that room?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length = 16 meters

Breadth = 12 meters

Height = 15 meters

**Concept: **

Length of the largest rod that can be put in a room is equal to the length of the diagonal of that

room.

**Formula used:**

Diagonal of a cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²)

Where l, b, and h are respectively the length, breadth, and height of a room

**Calculation:**

Length of longest rod = √(16² + 12² + 15²)

⇒ Length of longest rod = √(256 + 144 + 225) = √625 = 25m

∴ **Length of longest rod = 25 m**

questions.question: Ramesh purchases 75 articles for ₹ 10800 and sells them at a loss equal to the selling price of 5 articles. What will be the selling price of one article?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loss = CP of 75 articles − SP of 75 articles = SP of 5 articles

⇒ CP of 75 articles = SP of (75 + 5) articles = SP of 80 articles

⇒ SP of 80 articles = Total CP = ₹10800

⇒ SP of 1 article = 10800 ÷ 80 = 135

**∴ The correct answer is ₹135.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/070a422e37bfd9f9d264fe294fdb7e20be7a8096580f71bdbb4eac822ea90045.png] 

**Given:**

Total articles purchased = 75

Total Cost Price (CP) = ₹10800

Loss incurred = Selling Price (SP) of 5 articles

**Formula Used:**

Loss = Total CP − Total SP

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP of 75 articles − Total SP of 75 articles = Loss

⇒ ₹10800 − SP of 75 articles = SP of 5 articles

⇒ ₹10800 = SP of 75 articles + SP of 5 articles

⇒ ₹10800 = SP of 80 articles

⇒ SP of 1 article = 10800 ÷ 80

⇒ SP of 1 article = 135

**∴ The correct answer is ₹135.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Equation

Profit occurs when SP > CP (Profit = SP − CP), and Loss occurs when CP > SP (Loss = CP − SP).

Similar Concept (Profit in terms of SP)

If there is a profit equal to the SP of y articles on selling x articles, then CP of x articles = SP of (x − y) articles.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 | Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100. Both are computed on the Cost Price by default.

questions.question: After giving a discount of 25%, a shopkeeper earns 40% profit. Marked price is what percent more than the cost price? (approx.)
questions.solution:

Discount Percentage = 25%

Profit Percentage = 40%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price : Marked Price = (100 - Discount percentage) : (100 + Profit percentage)

**Calculation:**

Cost price : Marked price = (100 - 25) : (100 + 40)

⇒ Cost price : Marked price = 75 : 140

⇒ Cost price : Marked price = 15 : 28

Let the cost price be 15x and marked price be 28x

Difference between marked price and cost price = 13x

∴ Percentage by which MP is greater than CP = (13x / 15x) × 100 = 260 / 3 = 86.67%

∴ The required percentage is 86.67%.
